title: 综合实战：用广播计算批量距离矩阵（无显式循环）
code:
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
X = rng.random((5, 3))          # 5 个样本，3 维特征
print("X shape =", X.shape)
print(X)
print()

# 方法一：显式双重循环
n = X.shape[0]
D_loop = np.zeros((n, n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        D_loop[i, j] = np.sqrt(np.sum((X[i] - X[j]) ** 2))

# 方法二：广播（利用 (n,1,d) - (1,n,d) -> (n,n,d)）
diff = X[:, None, :] - X[None, :, :]
D_bc = np.sqrt(np.sum(diff ** 2, axis=-1))

print("循环法结果对角元:", np.diag(D_loop))
print("广播法结果对角元:", np.diag(D_bc))
print("对角元全为 0:", np.allclose(np.diag(D_bc), 0))
print("两法一致:", np.allclose(D_loop, D_bc))
print("对称:", np.allclose(D_bc, D_bc.T))
print()
print("广播法距离矩阵（保留 4 位）:")
print(np.round(D_bc, 4))
print()

# 方法三：用内积展开避免构造 (n,n,d) 中间数组（内存友好）
sq = np.sum(X ** 2, axis=1, keepdims=True)
D_dot = np.sqrt(np.maximum(sq + sq.T - 2 * X @ X.T, 0))
print("内积展开法与广播法一致:", np.allclose(D_dot, D_bc))
print()
print("=== 内存对比 ===")
print("广播法中间数组 diff 大小:", f"{diff.nbytes:,}", "字节（shape", diff.shape, "）")
print("内积法最大中间数组大小:", f"{D_dot.nbytes:,}", "字节（shape", D_dot.shape, "）")
print()
print("结论：n 很大时，(n,n,d) 的中间数组会成为瓶颈（O(n^2 d)）；")
print("      用内积展开 ||x-y||^2 = ||x||^2 + ||y||^2 - 2 x.y 可把中间量降到 O(n^2)。")
